correctness.rationale: For all m>=1, reconstruction uses the actual ordinary undirected 2-to-1 move, hub plus m paired leaves, full arbitrary configurations and a single target vertex. Every petal of mass >=4 is discharged into the hub with a precise floor((s-2)/2) deposit, and all 0..3 cases give p_i-r_i >= (s_i-4)/2. At total 4m this yields H>=R+1; clearing the R residual petals leaves >=1 hub pebble. The case H-R=3 is handled separately by retaining a last residual triangle or postponing a positive-deposit petal and applying the K3 four-pebble clearing lemma. The 4m-1 heavy-petal witness (2m+1,0), others (1,1), cannot produce a sole stack: conservation 2u_i+s_i=w_i+o_i forces center deficits for emptied light petals and limits heavy export to m-1; peripheral final piles 1,2,>=4 reduce to clearability while the size-three possibilities are excluded by the same flux balance. For m=1, all-one K3 is the obstruction. Finite independent state reachability (m<=3) corroborates but is not an all-m proof; monotone upward guarantee and all-one low-mass configurations exclude smaller threshold candidates.
